condition_note: GPT Image 2, one single-shot privacy edit from a fixed prompt
attribution: recorded in the source results.json under metadata.model
role: independent scorer; none of these four models is inside a protection loop
metric: great-circle error in km between the model's guess and the Cityscapes GPS ground truth (haversine, R = 6371.0 km)
cross_check: recomputed haversine(ground truth, location_estimate) equals the recorded prediction_errors_km for all 348 responses, to 0.0 km at R = 6371.0

unscored.why: gemini-3.1-pro-preview hits a 250-requests-per-model-per-day cap; every unscored call returned HTTP 429 and was recorded with a null error and a null location_estimate. No reasoning was produced, so no file is emitted.

vs_raw_on_the_same_images.note: 'moved further away' + 'located closer' + 'identical coordinate before and after' = n. An identical pair is the model returning the same rounded lat/lon for both images — a city-centroid guess the edit did not disturb.
